meta.title: Two bids: award a split: 6 units to B and 4 units to A; approver rejects
gaps: The prepared closed RFQ has only one bid, so awarding 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A, including the two-vendor allocation and total of 940, cannot be tested.
Sign in as the approver and reject the proposal with a remark requires another user's session.
Verify that no purchase order is created after rejection.
Verify that the buyer can start awarding again from Master QCS after rejection.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared closed RFQ has only one bid, so awarding 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A, including the two-vendor allocation and total of 940, cannot be tested.; Sign in as the approver and reject the proposal with a remark requires another user's session.; Verify that no purchase order is created after rejection.; Verify that the buyer can start awarding again from Master QCS after rejection.

steps.note: Open Master QCS on the prepared closed RFQ.
Open the awarding screen for the available bid.
Allocate the available line to the single available vendor; a two-vendor split is not possible in this prepared state.
Assert that the available single-vendor allocation is selected.
Create and submit the proposal for the available allocation so the proposal-rejection portion can be handed to the approver.
Assert that the proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, and return to the buyer view

steps.note: The approver is another user and cannot be signed in by the catalog.
Assert that the proposal shows the rejected status after the approver action.
